name: P2 development: the vanished route cue, under the delayed-credit live regime
question: Does one continuing Brain.live life at the delayed-credit actor point learn to take the route its vanished cue named, at the one decision where only history tells the routes apart, on the development founders whose visible-cue control passed under the same regime?
note: The same regime, recipes, arms, budgets and evaluation as protocol-p2-route-visible-live.json, with the cue shown at event 0 only (cue_persists false). Run on the founders whose visible-cue control passed in that protocol's reading of 14 October 2026 (greedy first choice right on both routes and greedy whole-route success above the founder and random controls, at 1920 episodes): delayed on founders 1001, 1002, 1004 and 1005, arena on founders 1001, 1003 and 1004 (runner --seeds), so a failure here is a memory limit and not a learning or budget limit. The causal probe p2_route_probe.py then reads every trained checkpoint: the first-choice policy of each cue branch intact, after a trace erase, after a reset and after a trace transplant from the other branch. The regime is the one the recall world validated through the live interface on Cadence 0.83.0: the composed trace of 0.82.0 (amplitude 3.0, working-memory scale 1.2, retention 0) with the key-door nursery's delayed-credit actor point (lam 0.95, gamma 0.95, critic rate 5) at actor step 0.1 (delayed) or 0.03 (arena), the body's need 0.2 per moment and a youth of 300 moments, passed to Brain.compose as arousal={need, youth}, which patches the founder arousal config. The historical recipe keeps V5's brain so the contrast with the earlier reading is paired within founders. The grade caregiver is reward-only (no label), so the live interface takes it. Budget readings are arms of their own length: the 480-episode arm lives the first 480 episodes of the 1920-episode arm's schedule from the same founder checkpoint.
scope: component context use; development founders only; the first decision is the only one that needs history

delayed.note: the composed trace with the delayed-credit actor point at actor step 0.1; Brain.compose(inputs=9, actions=5, modules=(32,), seed, lateral=0.0, actor_lam=0.95, actor_gamma=0.95, actor_eta_critic=5.0, actor_eta=0.1, actor_eta_bias=0.01, arousal={'need': 0.2, 'youth': 300})

arena.note: the same at the arena founder's actor step 0.03

historical.note: V5's brain, as in the earlier reading: Brain.compose(inputs=9, actions=5, modules=(48, 24), seed, arousal=True); compose actor step 1.0, the founder arousal config

natural_live_480.note: the 480-episode budget reading of natural_live: the same founder through the first 480 episodes of the same schedule

natural_live.note: the continuing life, reward only, 1920 episodes

grade_live.note: the continuing life with the grade added to the pay of executed decisions in guided windows, 1920 episodes

natural_step.note: the interface control: Brain.step learns from every outcome; run for the delayed recipe only, 1920 episodes

schedule.unit: executed decisions of the whole life

caregiver.label: the required action of the observation shown now, after an executed nonterminal mistake in a guided window

caregiver_note: a wrong first collection ends the episode, so a corrective label never reaches the decision that needs history; the arms are reward-only and graded; the grade carries no label, so Brain.live takes it

evaluation.note: frozen copies with their own action stream; Brain.reset at every episode start equals the life's episode boundary for an act-only reader

seeds.confirmation_note: unopened until code, protocol digest, genes, thresholds and cost limits are frozen

analysis.primary: first-choice accuracy and whole-route success; context-blind ceiling 0.5 at the first choice; a founder passes when its greedy first choice is right on both routes and its greedy whole-route success is above the founder and random controls; the probe's intact reading above its trace-erased reading on both routes says the working trace carries the cue
